name: Baddie's Mash (Coming soon)
description: Open-source multimodal language architecture (weights will not be released). Currently, Baddie's Mash V0.1 is a clean, lightweight model that you can train on image + text datasets to respond with text. The architecture is easily adaptable to video and audio modalities — the Baddie's Mash architecture release is coming soon, followed by Baddie's Mash Star (currently in beta), the actual interactive agent you can talk to and have execute tasks for you (:
